visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Give hashCode a Real Value
visualizerParams.problemDescription: hashCode returns the constant 1 for every point. That is valid but puts every object in the same bucket. Compute it from x and y. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A constant hashCode is legal but turns every lookup into a linear scan of one giant bucket. Spreading the hashes with the fields used by equals keeps lookups fast.
